messages:
jen: Deploybot kicked off staged rollout v3.4.2 -> 10% in us-east-1. Change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Tagging @ops-oncall and @liam for quick vote.

deploy-bot: started rollout id=rr-4891234567 target=10% regions=[us-east-1] image=redwood/model:v3.4.2

deploy-bot: status update (T+2m): health=ok p50=35ms p95=120ms errors=0.15% throughput=120r/s

liam: quick question — what are our explicit rollback triggers for this pipeline?

jen: From the playbook: p95 > 250ms sustained 5m OR errors > 0.5% within 1m. Also immediate pin/rollback on kv-cache OOMs or model-tokenizer mismatch.

maria: noticing an increase in p99 traces on a subset of requests. small sample:

```
[23:01:14] request_id=abc123 model=v3.4.2 seq_len=1024 p95=360ms
stack: runtime:kv_cache:get -> attention_kv:evict -> gpu_queue:delay
```

ops-oncall: also getting a 5xx spike at the edge (0.6% this last minute). Not huge but crosses our 0.5% warning. :thinking_face:

devex-kay: Is this impacting embeddings only or gen endpoints too?

liam: looks like both chat/generation paths. I recommend pausing and pinning us-east-1 back to v3.4.1 while we investigate.

jen: quick vote: react with :thumbsup: to continue; :thumbsdown: to pause+rollback.

liam: :thumbsdown:

ops-oncall: :thumbsdown: (agree with pause)

maria: :thumbsup: (we should collect more traces first)

jen: :thumbsdown: — leaning conservative here, pin if quorum.

deploy-bot: pause accepted (quorum reached). initiating rollback id=rb-4891234567 target_region=us-east-1 -> v3.4.1

deploy-bot: rollback progress: draining new replicas -> shifting traffic -> verifying health

deploy-bot: rollback complete. us-east-1 now serving v3.4.1. metrics: p50=38ms p95=42ms errors=0.05%

jen: Thanks. I'll open a follow-up issue (INC-4891) with the log samples and assign to runtime/serving. Re-schedule a quiet warmup tomorrow 03:00 UTC to try a narrower canary and enable extra kv-cache tracing.

liam: noted — will add perf histograms to the release notes and flag the kv-cache tuning change.

devex-kay: adding note to release notes draft about rollback and conservative gate thresholds.

ops-oncall: marking this as handled in release channel. If we see recurrence I'll escalate to oncall-sre.

jen: closing loop here. Good call team. :white_check_mark:
